frontendExec.title: Plugin server-side execution
frontendExec.description: Decides which plugins may run server-side code (finders, page data) inside the web process. Built-in plugins are always allowed; for anything else only ids on the allow list may execute. A plugin without this grant still installs, activates and renders — it just receives none of the data it declared.

frontendExec.denyHint: Wins over built-in status and the allow list
frontendExec.admitAllHint: Ignores the admission decision and runs every plugin in the web process. For temporary troubleshooting of a misclassified package only — turn it back off afterwards.

admin.serviceHint: When enabled, users can call the Agent from the account area. Disabling does not delete existing conversations; past records stay viewable.
admin.modelHint: Connect an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; model costs are paid by the site. If a model-provider plugin is installed, its service takes priority.
admin.baseUrlHint: Enter the provider's public HTTPS API address, usually ending in /v1.
admin.modelNamePlaceholder: Enter a model ID the provider supports
admin.apiKeyPlaceholderSaved: Saved — leave blank to keep the current key
admin.apiKeyPlaceholderNew: Paste the API key from your provider
admin.apiKeyHint: The key is encrypted on the server and never exposed to users.
admin.retentionDaysHint: Counted from the last update; conversations not updated within the period are deleted.
admin.retentionCapHint: When over the cap, the least recently updated conversations are cleaned first.
admin.cleanupPolicy: A background job checks hourly and cleans at most 500 conversations per run. Deletion is permanent and also removes the messages and image links; original files in the media library and task execution audits are kept.
admin.lastCleanupMore: ; remaining records will be handled in later batches
admin.neverCleaned: Automatic cleanup has not run yet. Records are kept forever by default and are never deleted automatically.
admin.retentionSaved: Retention rules saved; they apply at the next automatic cleanup
admin.saveFirst: Save the rules before running a cleanup.
admin.cleanupTitle: Clean up conversations using the current rules?
admin.cleanupDescription: Only conversations that already meet the retention rules are cleaned, up to 500 per batch. Removed conversations and messages cannot be restored.
admin.clearDescription: The endpoint URL, default model and saved key will be removed. Without a model-provider plugin, the Agent cannot run new tasks.
admin.defaultModelHint: Pick one of the models the current provider offers; Agent runs use it by default.
admin.defaultModelHelp: A saved model that the provider no longer lists is ignored and the run falls back automatically.
admin.catalogEmpty: The current provider returned no models. Check its configuration.
admin.fallbackHintPlugin: A model-provider plugin is serving this site; the fallback endpoint below is only used when the plugin is unavailable.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.readPolicyFallback: This key has no policy yet; defaults were loaded
advanced.discoverHint: Enable and save the service first; tools are loaded using the current administrator's service credential. New tools default to risky writes — review each one before saving.
advanced.discovered: Tools loaded; review how each is handled before saving
advanced.noTools: The remote did not return a tool list
advanced.actionsHint: New actions accept no arguments by default; existing actions keep their reviewed argument schema. Changing the name, run mode or limits here does not rewrite the schema.
advanced.oauthEnvHint: Before deploying, set AGENT_PUBLIC_ORIGIN (public API address) and AGENT_WEB_ORIGIN (site address).

profiles.title: Execution policy
profiles.description: Set execution limits for a given API key. These limits never grant permissions the key does not already have; risky operations still need confirmation.
profiles.idHelp: Copy the key ID (tokenId) from API key management, not the key itself.
profiles.autonomyPropose: Propose actions for the user to confirm
profiles.budgetMinorHelp: Leave blank for no amount limit. The model provider must support pricing; otherwise tasks are rejected once an amount limit is set.
profiles.allowedModelsHelp: One model ID per line; leave blank to allow all available models.
profiles.approvalNotifyHelp: Optional. The user still receives their own notification.

mcpServers.title: External tools
mcpServers.description: Connect MCP services to give the Agent extra tools. Save the service first, then load and review its remote tools; users need the matching permission and their own credential.
mcpServers.idHelp: Use an identifier starting with a lowercase letter, e.g. cloud-tools; do not change it after saving.
mcpServers.name: Service name
mcpServers.urlHelp: Only resolvable public HTTPS addresses are supported.

oauthClients.title: App authorization
oauthClients.description: Register apps that may connect to this site's MCP over OAuth. Only registered, full redirect URIs are accepted; disabling an app revokes issued tokens.
oauthClients.idHelp: Enter the client_id agreed with the app; letters, digits, underscores and hyphens only.
oauthClients.name: App name
oauthClients.redirectUrisHelp: One full HTTPS URI per line. For local debugging, localhost or loopback HTTP addresses are allowed.

actions.title: Script actions
actions.description: Run pre-reviewed Docker scripts. The server must have Docker installed and the pinned-digest image pulled; actions run without network access as a non-root user, and every call needs user confirmation.
actions.idHelp: Use an identifier starting with a lowercase letter, e.g. check-service; the permission is agent.action.<id>.
actions.name: Action name
actions.imageHelp: Use the full sha256 digest; mutable tags such as latest are not allowed.
actions.argvHelp: The first line is the program path, then one argument per line. Shell composition is not supported. Input data arrives on stdin.
